correctness.rationale: There are 3^12=531441 matrices, reduced to exactly 5053 canonical agent/good relabeling classes. Complete exact rational certificates provide lotteries of <=4 complete allocations. A standard-library checker independently reconstructs each of the 81 complete allocations, proves EFX and nondomination for each positive-weight allocation, tests all six expected envy inequalities, and checks exact rational weight normalization; weighted orbit counts recover all 531441 labeled profiles.

value.rationale: The EFX+PO randomized existence problem has a sharp three-agent/four-good counterexample in general valuations, and previous positive guarantees are largely bi-valued or two-agent. The exact {1,2,3} case is a motivated first bounded three-level domain, includes 392 canonical matrices with all agents genuinely tri-valued, and yields uniformly small support for all 531441 labeled instances.
